picks.title: CorelDRAW now has an AI tool that designers might actually use
picks.excerpt: CorelDRAW's September update adds Text-to-Vector AI, generating editable vector illustrations from prompts rather than flat raster output.
picks.rationale: Shipped feature in a mainstream vector tool: prompt to editable vectors, not flat raster, so illustrators can use the output directly in their workflow.

picks.title: UserTesting's MCP Servers: AI Product Teams Need Human Insight Inside the Loop
picks.excerpt: UserTesting launched Model Context Protocol servers on Sept 25, turning human research insight into a tool call AI product and design teams can pull into agent workflows.
picks.rationale: New release (Sept 25) that lets design and research teams pull real user-testing insight into agent workflows as an MCP tool call.

picks.title: New Google Flow build now points to Nano Banana 2.1
picks.excerpt: A new Google Flow web build labels an upcoming image model as Nano Banana 2.1, replacing an earlier 2.5 Flash reference; Google has not announced it yet.
picks.rationale: Early signal of the next Nano Banana image model in Google's creative tool Flow; unannounced, so the copy should frame it as a leak, not a launch.

picks.title: Rendering Complex AI Reasoning States in a React Dashboard
picks.excerpt: A UI pattern walkthrough for surfacing an AI agent's live reasoning states in a dashboard so human operators can follow what it is doing.
picks.rationale: A reusable AI-UX pattern for showing an agent's live state so people can follow it. Designers of agent products can apply it directly.

picks.title: Viral AI animation sparks controversy over familiar character design
picks.excerpt: A viral AI-generated animation draws backlash for a character design that closely echoes an existing IP, reopening the originality debate around generative art.
picks.rationale: Fresh case of generative output echoing existing IP in character design, a live originality risk for designers who use generative tools.
